operation.summary: Change this device's profile (purposes, device type, model; same rules as the tab and the team backend) and its own permission switches: true/false sets one specifically, "default" returns it to the inherited (type, purpose) default; explicit owner.configuration grant required; no per-change phone approval

body.name: profile
body.description: {purposes: [up to 8 short ids such as primary, dedicated, network_controller, monitor, shared], device_type: phone|tablet|computer|tv|watch|camera|other, model: 1-80 characters}; omitted fields stay

body.name: switches
body.description: Switch id (GET permissions device.permissions[].id) to true, false or "default"

operation.returns: changed{profile,switches}, backend synced|pending|unchanged, device (as in GET); same values change nothing

profile.description: {purposes: [up to 8 short ids such as primary, dedicated, network_controller, monitor, shared], device_type: phone|tablet|computer|tv|watch|camera|other, model: 1-80 characters}; omitted fields stay

switches.description: Switch id (GET permissions device.permissions[].id) to true, false or "default"

idempotency_key.description: Any UUID; repeating the call with the same key within 24 h returns the first result instead of acting twice
